studies.unit_of_analysis: Community-dwelling Medicare beneficiaries in survey-weighted 2016 MCBS analyses

studies.design: Survey-weighted cross-sectional MCBS analysis with descriptive historical trends
studies.population: 12,625 community-dwelling beneficiaries: 2,155 under 65 and 10,470 aged 65+; recorded sex, identity unresolved
studies.payer: Traditional Medicare and Medicare Advantage; Part D/LIS, other drug coverage and no-drug-coverage strata
studies.finding: Female versus male adjusted odds of any cost-related nonadherence: 1.66 (95% CI 1.31–2.10) under 65 and 1.21 (1.04–1.41) aged 65+. Weighted prevalence: 40.5% versus 28.5% and 15.7% versus 12.8%, respectively. For ages 65+, cost-reduction-strategy OR 1.04 (0.94–1.14) includes the null.
studies.limitation: Self-report, residual confounding and continuous-enrollment/community selection; no current policy effect. Gender identity unresolved. Outcome-response Ns 2,150/10,457 differ from cohort Ns; model N and sex-specific event counts not established. Supplements not extracted.
studies.relevance: Direct historical patient-sex affordability candidate in shared systems/functions; retain outside confirmed-cisgender primary synthesis pending eligibility.

studies.unit_of_analysis: High-hospitalization-risk Medicare beneficiaries with five repeated CRN surveys

studies.identity_status: Not reported; cisgender identity not established
studies.design: Observational secondary longitudinal cohort pooling care-model trial arms
studies.population: 1,655 high-risk Chicago Medicare beneficiaries: 1,036 women and 619 men; 769 under 65 and 886 aged 65+; identity unresolved
studies.payer: Medicare-only and dual Medicare/Medicaid; specific Part D and Original Medicare/MA status not established
studies.data_period: 2012–2018 enrollment/study period; 3-month baseline recall plus 12-month follow-up, 5 surveys
studies.finding: Persistent CRN: 162/1,036 women (15.6%) versus 68/619 men (11.0%), unadjusted P=.008; adjusted woman:man OR 1.36 (95% CI 0.95–1.95), P=.10. Transient CRN adjusted OR 0.81 (0.62–1.07), P=.15. Preserve both adjusted intervals including the null.
studies.limitation: Selected single-center cohort, 87.7% Black; deaths/incomplete follow-up excluded; some missing CRN treated as not reported. Gender identity unresolved; adjusted associations do not identify causal bias. Exact model N/reference-outcome coding require verification before pooling.
studies.relevance: Direct patient-sex longitudinal affordability candidate; distinguishes persistence from annual any-CRN. Not national prevalence or confirmed-cisgender primary evidence.
studies.extraction_level: Full-text methods/results/limitations, Figure 2 and Tables 1–2 via PMC XML; AI preliminary
